# Layer system

Every surface sits in one of five layers. Layers 0 and 1 are flat; 2 to 4 are elevated. Then, within the page, three surfaces set what groups and what stands out.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/ElevationLayerSystem.mdx`

## The five layers

### Layer 0 · Frame

The ground the app sits on, and the docked Sidebar on it.

#### Usage & styling

- **Flat.** Never a shadow, never floats.
- **Docked Sidebar** shares the Frame; floating, it moves to Layer 3.

### Layer 1 · Page

The page and everything in its flow. What sits on it is broken down below, in Within the page.

#### Usage & styling

- **Flat by default.** Set off from the Frame by tone alone.
- **One surface, one pad.** The Page paints `--ds-surface` edge to edge with `--page-pad` on every side, and takes no radius, border or shadow. See Templates › Page.
- **A standalone Panel** sits on Default: `--ds-surface` with an edge line, and no shadow. Only a floating Panel moves to Layer 3. See Templates › Panel.

### Layer 2 · Navigation

Edges that stay put while content scrolls under them: a sticky table header and column.

#### Usage & styling

- **Border first;** the overflow shadow appears only once content scrolls beneath.

#### Stacking

`--layer-card`

### Layer 3 · Non-blocking overlay

Floats while the page stays usable: the floating Sidebar and Panel, Popup types, Inline edit, Flag, Spotlight, a dragged Card.

#### Usage & styling

- **Overlay pair,** no border. The floating Sidebar and Panel wear the overlay material instead of the solid fill: translucent, no blur, with a 1px material edge, and solid under reduced transparency and increased contrast.
- **Dark mode:** steps lighter.

#### Stacking

`--layer-navigation` · `--layer-popup` · `--layer-flag` · `--layer-spotlight`

### Layer 4 · Blocking overlay

The Modal, and nothing else.

#### Usage & styling

- **Always on the Blanket;** nothing else dims the page.
- **Wears the overlay material** over the Blanket, with a 1px material edge, and keeps the blocking shadow.
- **One at a time;** a Flag may sit above it.
- **A confirm Modal may open over a Panel or a Popup,** with its own Blanket.
- **Popups and Tooltips open over a Modal.**
- **`--layer-*` tokens are set in code only.** Components name the token, never a number.

#### Stacking

`--layer-blanket` · `--layer-modal`

### Not a layer

A **Tooltip** labels a control: no shadow, `--layer-tooltip`.

## Within the page

Layer 1 has three surfaces: Default, Sunken and Raised.

### Default

Most of the page: a Section and its side, tables, lists, forms; rows are hairlines. A Default card is this surface with a border.

#### Usage & styling

- **A Section takes no surface:** no fill, no padding, no border.
- **A Default card** (`surface="default"`) takes `--ds-border`: on the Frame, on Sunken or colored areas, or when dense with its own rows.

### Sunken

A ground that groups static content: a Card (the default surface), the table’s empty box (`--ds-surface-sunken`, card radius), a clickable card at rest.

#### Usage & styling

- **Only on the Default surface;** one step only, never a Card inside a Card.
- **Flat:** no shadow, and a transparent 1px border that shows only in forced colors.
- **The default card surface** (`surface="sunken"`). A clickable one lifts to Raised on hover, in place.

### Raised

The one card a view is about, a clickable card on hover, a grabbed control.

#### Usage & styling

- **One per view at rest,** placed first in reading order.
- **Always the pair:** raised surface with raised shadow. In dark its fill is the page tone, so the shadow does the lifting.
- **Hover lifts in place;** the card never moves.
- **Dragged,** it takes the overlay pair.

### By template

How a Section, its side and its detail sit on the page is in Templates › Section; the table and its empty box are in Templates › Table; the Card and its three surfaces are in Templates › Card. Elevation sets only their surface: a Section takes none.
